mentions.name: navigation-ponyfill
mentions.description: A JavaScript ponyfill for the browser's new Navigation API. It implements navigation.canGoBack and the currententrychange event to enable near-perfect back buttons with almost zero edge cases, which is very tricky with the older History API. A new PR adds entries() and currentEntry support, and future work plans full-blown navigations with navigation interceptors so framework router implementations can be built wholly on the Navigation API instead of history.pushState/replaceState.
mentions.problem: Implementing reliable back buttons with (almost) zero edge cases is surprisingly very tricky with the older History API.
